name: Hiyo
source:
A youkai that lives in an old house, she is also a land god with extremely high spiritual power. She is wealthy and an extremely beneficial being. She has been worshipped since ancient times.

Although she has lived longer than you might think from her appearance, her words and actions are still childish.
